title: Data Readiness for AI: A 360-Degree Survey
measurement_description: The paper does not specifically measure or evaluate faith or religion. It is a 360-degree survey of metrics used to verify data readiness and quality for AI training (DRAI). Religion is mentioned only once in passing as an example of a sensitive attribute that a 'Bias Indicator' metric might check for in textual data.
findings: There are no findings related to religion. The paper reviews 140+ sources to build a taxonomy of data readiness metrics (data quality, outliers, bias, fairness, privacy, and multimedia quality) for AI applications.
